name: Package AC units
description: Outdoor packaged systems designed for medium to large spaces needing higher capacities and straightforward installation.
long_description: A package unit holds the compressor, condenser, evaporator and blower in one cabinet, usually placed on a rooftop or outdoor platform. Conditioned air is ducted into the building. Because everything is in one place, installation is quicker and servicing happens outside the occupied space, with no disruption indoors.
features: All major components in a single weatherproof cabinet
Rooftop or ground placement keeps plant out of sight
Servicing happens outdoors, with no disruption inside
Common in auditoriums, warehouses, gyms and workshops
considerations: Check roof or platform strength for the unit's weight
Short duct runs from the unit to the space improve efficiency
Needs crane or hoist access for rooftop placement

faqs.question: Package AC or ductable split?
faqs.answer: A package unit keeps all machinery outdoors and is quick to install. A ductable split suits sites where there's no roof or platform space for a full cabinet.

faqs.question: Do you handle rooftop placement?
faqs.answer: Yes. We coordinate lifting, the mounting frame, vibration isolation and duct connections.
